findings.title: The 512 KiB budget excludes the actual MCP response wrapper
findings.scenario: A student has 37 preserved section records with an 18,000-character Korean note each. limit=250 produces a byte-limited page of 9 records. SavedContext checks only its inner JSON; server.result emits the complete same payload in both content[0].text and structuredContent.
findings.observed: Official SDK in-memory response: CallToolResult 979074 bytes and JSON-RPC envelope 979108 bytes, despite MAX_QUERY_BYTES=524288. No tool error was returned.
findings.impact: A caller or connector enforcing the declared whole-response limit can reject or truncate a page even though this implementation reports a successful continuing page; the new large-query delivery guarantee is false.
findings.recommendation: Compute the byte budget against the actual serialized MCP envelope, including duplicated/escaped text and structured content, and test the official SDK result envelope using large Unicode fixtures. Keep one-record refusal and first-unread cursor guarantees.

findings.title: The committed input contract requires an optional defaulted facets field
findings.scenario: The documented student_history request omits facets. Runtime parsing and actual SDK tools/list accept that request, but the committed academy_query.input schema lists facets as required.
findings.observed: Runtime accepted default facets; official SDK tools/list required=false; committed schema required=true. The static schema also omits the runtime duplicate-facet refinement.
findings.impact: A client, form or preflight validator generated from the published inspection contract rejects a request that the README and actual tool accept, so saved and live contract surfaces disagree.
findings.recommendation: Export input schemas in input mode, preserve or explicitly document duplicate-facet runtime refinement, regenerate the committed artifact, and assert static/runtime/SDK equivalence for the documented omitted-facets request.

advisories.title: All configured history facets do not include lesson overlay observations
advisories.details: student_history delegates to the nine student_records facets. Synthetic lesson overlay observations remain exposed only by lesson_context at lines64-68. Default history returns14 facet records but excludes1 overlay observation. This is consistent with the closed facet contract, so it is not a blocking facet-enumeration defect.
advisories.recommendation: Name the coverage explicitly in consumer preparation flows, or retain a separate dated lesson_context read; do not infer complete saved student history from default student_history exhaustion.
